summary: Race render resource allocation. Builds a 25-slot pointer array at this+0x10, each slot filled by Direct3DObjectFactory(index) only when IDTypePermissionMatrix permits that index for the current championship mode (dword_7D0410). Allocates a 3-slot sub-object array (first slot this+29) via sub_4DB420, conditionally creates one object at this+0xC when RangeCheck_93e0(0, mode) passes, and stores a fixed-node allocator at this+0xD8. Returns 0. Called once during race init from RaceInitWithConstants.

operations.description: Load the current championship/race mode global dword_7D0410 into a local used by the permission and range checks. Invoked from RaceInitWithConstants.
For index 0..24, gate each slot on IDTypePermissionMatrix(index, mode): when permitted, store Direct3DObjectFactory(index) into the 25-entry pointer array beginning at this+0x10.
For index 0..2, store sub_4DB420(index) into the 3-slot sub-object array whose first slot is this+29.
When RangeCheck_93e0(0, mode) passes, store sub_4DC220(0) at this+0xC.
Store the FixedNodeAllocator() result at this+0xD8.
